mission: Hardening CI, E2E coverage, and autonomous orchestration for AgencyOS

tasks.title: Audit CI telemetry & chunk runtime
tasks.description: Review recent merge-guardian runs; capture memory usage per chunk; document flaky suites.
acceptance_criteria: A run-history table with chunk duration/exit status
List of suites still approaching memory ceiling

tasks.title: Design long-term runner strategy
tasks.description: Decide on hosted vs self-hosted runners; outline job/scaling plan for resilient CI.
acceptance_criteria: Comparison of hosted vs self-hosted trade-offs

tasks.title: Refactor merge-guardian workflow
tasks.description: Break long job into individual steps/jobs; add instrumentation; ensure concurrency cancellation does not discard latest logs.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow YAML runs each chunk in isolated job or step
Chunk logs clearly labelled and persisted
CI run for branch completes without manual cancellation

tasks.title: CI stabilization verification
tasks.description: Run full workflow twice back-to-back; capture telemetry; document proof of stability.
acceptance_criteria: Two consecutive successful runs (no manual cancel)

tasks.title: Catalogue current E2E/integration tests
tasks.description: Map existing coverage in tests/foundation_automation, tests/integration; note gaps against autonomous workflow requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix of current scenarios vs desired behaviors

tasks.title: Spec: Autonomous fix loop E2E
tasks.description: Write spec for end-to-end autonomous bug fix scenario (backlog entry → planner/coder/tester → real pytest → commit).

tasks.title: Implement autonomous fix loop test
tasks.description: Create temp repo fixture; orchestrate real planner/coder/tester calls; execute pytest for failing test; assert fix & commit generation.

tasks.title: Spec: Spec-driven feature delivery E2E
tasks.description: Define scenario covering Article V: backlog with spec, planner generates tasks, coder implements feature + doc, QA verifies.

tasks.title: Implement spec-driven feature delivery test
tasks.description: Create new E2E test that feeds structured spec through orchestrator; asserts code+docs+reports generated; checks vector store updates.
acceptance_criteria: Validates spec artifacts, code changes, telemetry entries

tasks.title: Cross-agent handoff E2E
tasks.description: Add scenario with multiple specialized agents (frontend/backend QA, doc) and verify handoff log ordering and context persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Assertions on log timeline + context payload

tasks.title: E2E regression verification
tasks.description: Run full E2E suite (new + existing) locally and in CI; document runbook & runtime impact.
acceptance_criteria: All E2E tests pass locally and in CI

tasks.title: Codify agent role specs
tasks.description: Create YAML definitions for planner, coder, QA, doc, ops agents—including prompts, tools, and guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Peer review by ops & QA leads

tasks.title: Implement orchestrator CLI
tasks.description: Build scripts/orchestrate.py that reads backlog entries, instantiates role agents via Claude 4.5 Sonnet (Thinking) or local 120B, and logs events.
acceptance_criteria: CLI supports backlog task selection (/primeA --graph execution)

tasks.title: Integrate local 120B LLM for heavy roles
tasks.description: Expose GPT-OSS120B via local HTTP/gRPC; update router so planner/auditor optionally use it; log token usage.
acceptance_criteria: Local LLM server running with health check

tasks.title: Deploy autonomous work cell
tasks.description: Automate backlog → spec → plan → code → audit → test → telemetry cycle; run continuously in tmux with guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Continuous loop processes backlog tasks autonomously
All changes gated by tests & policy checks

tasks.title: Daily autonomous report generator
tasks.description: Summarize backlog status, telemetry anomalies, E2E outcomes; deliver via Markdown/Slack/email.
acceptance_criteria: Includes test status, backlog changes, alerts

tasks.title: Governance + policy review
tasks.description: Ensure guardrails/policies enforced (schema changes, security, legal) before full autonomy rollout.
